runtime_session_receipt.schema_note: This is NOT the codex probe-receipt schema crypto.autoresearch.codex_runtime_session_receipt.v1 used by the superseded predecessor TASK-20260811-338053. That schema describes a short read-only probe process. No probe process exists here, so a probe schema would have nothing to describe. This schema describes the authoring session itself.

identity.session_uuid_note: This runtime exposes no session UUID to the agent. None is invented.

inference.separate_fields_note: requested_policy and resolved_model_id are recorded as SEPARATE fields here and in every other artifact of this task. They are never collapsed into one value and neither is written in place of the other.

authoring_session_binding.receipt_scope: the entire authoring span of the single session that wrote all six declared artifacts of TASK-20260815-3f7098
authoring_session_binding.gap_impossibility_reason: The coordinator role's declared tool surface in .claude/agents/coordinator.md is exactly Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, SendMessage. It contains no command-execution tool, so this session could not launch a separate probe process even in principle. A probe-versus-authoring split is therefore not merely absent from this receipt but not constructible in this session.
authoring_session_binding.predecessor_defect_repaired: The superseded receipt at coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-001/batches/BATCH-080a9c/tasks/TASK-20260811-338053/runtime-session-receipt.v2.json verified a short read-only probe exec session and conceded in its own scope_note that it did not prove that later interactive authoring tokens ran inside that probe. This receipt makes no such split and therefore makes no such concession.

resolution_provenance.reason_not_executed: This role has no command-execution tool (see gap_impossibility_reason). Asserting that this session ran the command would be a fabricated command output and is refused.
resolution_provenance.output_source: propagated verbatim from three committed records that carry the resolution as a given to this Coordinator

independent_static_cross_check.method: direct read of committed configuration files by this authoring session. No process was launched, no backend was contacted, no probe was performed, and no digest was computed.
independent_static_cross_check.conclusion: The propagated resolution string is consistent with committed state on all three of its components: the policy name, the model that the default anthropic backend binds that policy to, and the requested reasoning effort. This is a configuration cross-check, not a backend probe, and it is labelled as such.
independent_static_cross_check.what_this_does_not_establish: It does not establish that the anthropic backend served claude-opus-5 for this session's tokens. No committed probe exists: the binding's last_probed is null.

authoring_session_self_report.source: the runtime system context presented to this authoring session
authoring_session_self_report.note: This is the authoring session reporting its own runtime-declared model identity. It is recorded as a self-report and labelled as one; it is not presented as an external attestation.

policy_honoured.refusal_alternative_considered: The handoff forbids fallback and degradation and instructs refusal rather than downgrade. No downgrade occurred, so no refusal was required.

limitations: This binding is an authoring-session self-attestation cross-checked against committed configuration. It is not a third-party or cryptographic attestation, and it is not claimed to be one.

The anthropic binding for coordinator-orchestration-code carries last_probed: null, so no `python -m orchestration.adapter doctor --probe` confirmation exists in committed state for this backend/policy pair.

The runtime exposes no session UUID and no per-response reasoning-effort echo to the agent, so effort is recorded as a declared binding from committed policy and agent frontmatter, not as an observed measurement.

No SHA-256 digest anywhere in this task's artifacts was computed by this session; every digest is a quotation from a committed record with its citing source named. The snapshot and review tasks must verify them.

No git command was run by this session. The branch name recorded in the specification was read directly from .git/HEAD; the HEAD commit sha and working-tree state are for the isolated snapshot task TASK-20260815-1f9a8e to record.
